project.name: lending-library
project.description: The Lending Library: a small library lending app (legacy Jersey/Grizzly + Hibernate Java service).

nodes.name: export-csv.md
nodes.summary: Describes the semicolon-separated CSV format returned by GET /loans (id, member, isbn, lent on, due on, returned on), which spreadsheet users rely on.

nodes.name: reports-spec.md
nodes.summary: Specification of a monthly lending report from a removed reporting module: one row per member with loans started, late returns and total late fees, sorted by fees. Only the spec remains; no code exists.

nodes.name: pom.xml
nodes.summary: Maven build for the lending-library artifact, declaring Jersey/Grizzly, Hibernate and H2 dependencies and a dependency-copy plugin.

nodes.name: run.sh
nodes.summary: Shell launcher that builds the project with Maven (skipping tests) and starts lib.App using the compiled classes and copied dependencies.

nodes.name: AboutPage.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource serving GET /about by returning the static about.html classpath resource.

nodes.name: AboutPage
nodes.summary: Resource class mapped to /about that reads and returns about.html as text/html.

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: GET handler that loads /static/about.html from the classpath and returns it as a UTF-8 string.

nodes.name: App.java
nodes.summary: Application entry point: creates the JPA EntityManagerFactory, wires the repository into the resources, and starts a Grizzly HTTP server on PORT (default 8080).

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Builds the object graph, registers JAX-RS resources, starts the server and installs a shutdown hook closing the server and EMF.

nodes.name: FinePayments.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for POST /payments/{id} that verifies the loan exists and charges the late fee via an external payment gateway.

nodes.name: FinePayments
nodes.summary: Resource that proxies fine payments to the gateway configured by PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL.

nodes.name: pay
nodes.summary: Returns 404 for unknown loans, otherwise POSTs a charge to the gateway and maps its status to 200 or 502.

nodes.name: LateFeeView.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource rendering an HTML page with a loan's late fee (25 cents/day, capped at $10, waived within 2 days).

nodes.name: LateFeeView
nodes.summary: Resource mapped to /fees that computes and displays late fees.

nodes.name: page
nodes.summary: Looks up the loan, computes days late and the fee in cents, and returns an HTML fee page or 404.

nodes.name: Loan.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for a book loan mapped to the LOAN table, with a 14-day due date rule.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Entity holding id, member, isbn, lent and returned dates, with dueOn() and markReturned().

nodes.name: LoanRepository.java
nodes.summary: Repository encapsulating JPA access to loans, with helpers that manage EntityManager and transaction lifecycles.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Provides all, find, lend and markReturned over Loan using read/write unit-of-work helpers.

nodes.name: lend
nodes.summary: Creates and persists a new loan with an id derived from the current loan count.

nodes.name: markReturned
nodes.summary: Marks a loan returned on a date and merges it, or returns empty if not found.

nodes.name: write
nodes.summary: Runs work in a transaction, committing on success and rolling back if still active.

nodes.name: LoanResource.java
nodes.summary: JAX-RS resource for /loans: list, get, lend and return endpoints emitting semicolon-separated plain-text lines.

nodes.name: LoanResource
nodes.summary: Resource exposing GET /loans, GET /loans/{id}, POST /loans and POST /loans/{id}/return.

nodes.name: line
nodes.summary: Formats a Loan as a semicolon-separated line (id, member, isbn, lent, due, returned).

nodes.name: persistence.xml
nodes.summary: JPA persistence unit "library" using in-memory H2, drop-and-create schema generation and seed.sql loading for lib.Loan.

nodes.name: seed.sql (LOAN)
nodes.summary: Seed script inserting three sample loans into the LOAN table at startup.

nodes.name: about.html
nodes.summary: Static about page with opening hours, 14-day lending period and contact address.

nodes.name: LOAN
nodes.summary: Table LOAN mapped by JPA entity Loan

layers.name: API & Application Layer
layers.description: Application entry point and HTTP-facing JAX-RS resources and views, including the static about page.

layers.name: Domain & Data Access Layer
layers.description: JPA entities, repositories, fine payment logic, and seed data for the H2 database.

layers.name: Configuration & Build Layer
layers.description: Maven build, JPA persistence configuration, and run script.

layers.name: Documentation Layer
layers.description: Specification documents for reports and CSV export.

tour.title: App Entry Point
tour.description: App.java is the entry point. It creates the JPA EntityManagerFactory and wires up the Grizzly/Jersey server and its resources. There is no README, so start here.

tour.title: Running the App
tour.description: run.sh builds the project with Maven, skipping tests, and launches the server. It is the quickest way to get the app running locally.

tour.title: Loan Domain Entity
tour.description: Loan is the JPA entity mapped to the LOAN table. It carries the 14-day due-date logic that the rest of the app builds on.

tour.title: Data Access
tour.description: LoanRepository encapsulates JPA access to loans and manages the transaction helpers. Resources go through it instead of touching the EntityManager directly.

tour.title: Loan REST API
tour.description: LoanResource exposes /loans to list, get, lend and return books. It is the core JAX-RS endpoint and is backed by the repository.

tour.title: Fees and Payments
tour.description: LateFeeView renders a loan's late fee as an HTML page. FinePayments handles POST /payments/{id} after checking that the loan exists. Both build on the Loan model.

tour.title: Static About Page
tour.description: AboutPage serves the static about.html at GET /about. The page lists opening hours, the 14-day lending period and contact details.
